SENSOR FIELD GUIDE

Drone lamps show illumination, not sensor range. Press M for patrol sectors: H is flight height; R is maximum sensor range.

Solid walls, roofs, and cover block sight. Crouching slows detection. Darkness and visual fog do not provide extra concealment. Graphics settings never change detection.

White underside lights mean patrol; amber means investigation. A surviving drone evades incoming fire; nearby witnesses investigate the attack. An unseen takedown does not automatically raise the alarm.

A confirmed camera or drone lock alerts every surviving patrol for the rest of the mission. Red lights persist and patrols move faster. Disabling the reporting camera cannot erase a broadcast. Break sight to cancel targeting: drones search the last reported position, not your hidden location. One drone hit is fatal unless you have the single-use ration buffer.
